kjv: neither doth God respect any person
mine: But God will not take away life
note: welo'-yissa' 'elohim nefesh means "God does not take away a life". It is not about God showing partiality (nasa' panim). The woman's argument is that God seeks to restore, not destroy.

mine: when he (Absalom) cut the hair of his head
note: Poll (to cut hair) is obsolete. The Hebrew is gallach, "shave/cut".
